info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Data By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Data Retrieval API provides access to key market data through the specified quant model parameter. It allows users to obtain up-to-date financial market information filtered by specific parameters, which can aid in decision-making processes for investment strategies. This API is commonly utilized by financial analysts, traders, and developers seeking to integrate market insights into their applications. By leveraging this endpoint, consumers can enhance their analysis capabilities and streamline data-driven financial operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the quantitative model data for the specified resource. It's essential for analysis and decision-making processes within the market data framework.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to retrieve market data related to the quant model identified by RES-100045. The information provided in the body is crucial for tailoring the data retrieval to specific parameters and query requirements.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the requested market data.
